description: This file defines a wizard for handling stock return operations in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including generating return lines, creating return pickings, and opening related views.

classes.name: wizard_return_picking
classes.description: A wizard interface class for handling stock return operations with defined states.

methods.name: make_default
methods.description: Creates a default value function for form fields.

methods.name: _get_returns
methods.description: Prepares the return lines form, fetching pickings and move lines, and setting up fields.

methods.name: _create_returns
methods.description: Creates return pickings and moves based on user input, handling quantities and return types.

methods.name: _action_open_window
methods.description: Opens a window to display the created return picking.
